description: Fail-closed semantic acceptance requirements for every Week84-92 Gate. A Gate cannot pass from an arbitrary green command: every required commandId, assertionId, evidence basename, minimum count, and applicable frozen policy must be satisfied.

fieldSemantics.requiredCommandIds: Gate result commands must contain every exact semantic commandId and be Passed. goal-evidence-semantic-validate binds the unique frozen semantic test-report; every other command binds both its Gate-local adapter observation report and at least one independent oracle/test verifier report. The verifier must raw-hash-bind the adapter report, exact candidate checkout, commandId, exit, source and test counts. Adapter output never self-attests Passed and never contributes Gate counts before verifier acceptance. Generic Passed JSON is not command execution evidence.
fieldSemantics.requiredAssertionIds: Gate result acceptanceAssertions must contain every exact semantic assertionId, be Passed, and bind at least one resolved in-Gate evidenceRef.
fieldSemantics.minimumCommandCount: Lower bound for executed command receipts; it is never smaller than requiredCommandIds length.
fieldSemantics.minimumTestCount: Lower bound that both discovered and passed tests must satisfy. Every positive value requires a Gate-local test-report emitted by the bootstrap-frozen executor, bound to its source hash, exact Gate/candidate/allowed command/timestamps/exit and distinct hash-bound UTF-8 stdout/stderr; counts must be parsed from frozen runner output rather than supplied as an untrusted claim. A zero value requires zeroMinimumTestBasis.
fieldSemantics.requiredEvidenceKinds: Required Gate-result evidence kinds from 84_92_week_gate_result.schema.json; each kind must resolve to a hash-bound item at the exact Gate-local canonical path under <group-root>/gate-evidence/<gateId>/, except the separately frozen provider-ledger-binding path.
fieldSemantics.requiredEvidenceBasenames: Required evidence file basenames declared by the source plan; each basename must appear exactly once for its Gate, its path must be globally unique across Gate results, and each raw file hash plus JSON/test-report payload must reconcile with the Gate result and exact candidate.
fieldSemantics.commandControl: The Gate-local prior-sealed command-control document, predecessor mode, source trust, source verification mapping, and role policy. Every nonsemantic product command requires one exact observation-only adapter plus an independent oracle/test with exact fully-qualified unittest arguments and verifiesCommandIds coverage. Provider runtimeDrivers must be strict-prior W84-G5 fixture/parser sources and cannot contribute verifier authority.
fieldSemantics.frozen: References immutable numeric policies, viewport sets, workload shapes, and compatibility conditions defined in this manifest.
fieldSemantics.providerRequirement: Null unless the source plan mandates real-provider or controlled-write turns for this Gate. Provider Gates also freeze the immutable boundary-decision path, allowed boundary modes, and exact package-launch receipt count.
fieldSemantics.controlledWrite: True only for the two user-authorized controlled-write Gates.

workloads.week84-listener-ownership: Frozen approval/interruption/recovery/cancel and symmetric two-frame observation sequence.
workloads.provider-five-profile: Five consecutive profiles, each one warm-up plus five measured turns.
workloads.desktop-shell-15-cases: Five frozen fixtures across the three frozen viewports.
workloads.terminal-lifecycle: Open/input/cancel/close and panel unmount/remount ownership scenarios.
workloads.cli-full-scenario-manifest: Baseline and candidate command/help/output/error/schema/exit scenarios with identical fixtures.
workloads.cross-surface-matrix: Equivalent CLI and AppHost safety conclusions plus package/store/config isolation.
workloads.independent-dual-build: Two clean build roots from the exact Week92 candidate.

gates.zeroMinimumTestBasis: The Gate is an independent user visual attestation over already-automated W86-R1 through W86-R6 evidence.
The plan explicitly permits a reasoned NotRun when the optional real tool or authorization is unavailable; fake/default correctness is independently required by W88-C3.
The Gate is the independent user visual decision plus ledger and final-decision closure; all automated product acceptance is required by W92-G1 through W92-G8.
